rationale: Resident must first address with attending; correct ethical pathway is to insist disclosure cannot be omitted before escalating.
Cisplatin causes ototoxicity (tinnitus, SNHL) in bladder cancer chemo; mechanism is DNA cross-linking.
Post-catheterization with livedo reticularis, eosinophilia, AKI, and intravascular spindle-shaped (cholesterol cleft) vacuoles is classic cholesterol embolization.
Septic shock + DIC from pelvic source; lipid A (phosphorylated GlcNAc dimer with fatty acids = LPS) implicates gram-negative; E. coli ferments lactose on MacConkey.
Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis; first-line is mast cell stabilizer/antihistamine eye drops (ketotifen).
Cocaine-induced chest pain; beta-blockers contraindicated (unopposed alpha); CCB (diltiazem) or benzodiazepine first.
Elderly diabetic man with HTN and unilateral hydroureter/hydronephrosis—common iliac artery aneurysm compresses ureter as it crosses the pelvic brim.
Post-PCI for ACS requires dual antiplatelet therapy: aspirin + P2Y12 inhibitor (clopidogrel).
Active/recurrent PID is an absolute contraindication to copper IUD placement.
Nail pitting in young patient — psoriasis association; silvery plaques on extensor surfaces.
HIV confirmatory test is now the HIV-1/HIV-2 antibody differentiation immunoassay (replaced Western blot in CDC algorithm).
JAK2+ myelofibrosis with massive splenomegaly, anemia, marrow fibrosis—treat with JAK inhibitor ruxolitinib.
NF2 (merlin gene, chromosome 22) — bilateral vestibular schwannomas and meningiomas.
Standing reduces venous return → decreased preload → reduced diastolic filling time/volume.
Reassortment of segmented genomes (e.g., rotavirus, influenza) produces new strains.
Porcelain (calcified) gallbladder strongly associated with gallbladder cancer—must exclude first.
IL-4 drives IgE class switching in allergic/atopic asthma.
Matching cases and controls on age, SES, and family history is the textbook example of matching to control confounding.
Acute pericarditis (positional sharp pain, friction rub); standard treatment NSAIDs + colchicine.
Somnolence, ataxia, slurred speech, diminished DTRs with only 0.04% alcohol — suggests added CNS depressant; benzodiazepine intoxication fits.
Prior radiation therapy is the established risk factor for secondary DLBCL.
VSD with holosystolic murmur at LLSB in infant with poor feeding — DiGeorge (22q11 deletion) commonly causes conotruncal/VSD anomalies.
Mississippi River valley travel, urinary polysaccharide antigen, intracellular dimorphic fungus in macrophages — Histoplasma capsulatum.
Hospital-acquired pneumonia (>48h after admission) most commonly Staphylococcus aureus or gram-negative rods; S. aureus best fit among options.
Silent chest with lethargy after failed maximal therapy = impending respiratory failure → intubate.
Chronic granulomatous disease — NADPH oxidase defect, failed NBT test; defective respiratory burst.
Croup (barking cough, stridor) — subglottic narrowing 'steeple sign' on neck X-ray.
Rifampin induces CYP3A4, accelerating estrogen/progesterone metabolism and reducing OCP efficacy.
Post-diarrheal illness with ascending weakness and areflexia = Guillain-Barré; CSF shows albuminocytologic dissociation (elevated protein, normal cells).
Flexible metatarsus adductus (corrects with stimulation) — reassurance; resolves spontaneously.
Acute cholecystitis — cystic duct obstruction; HIDA scan showing gallbladder non-visualization confirms.
Heart failure with preserved EF / diastolic dysfunction — stiff ventricle shifts the diastolic filling curve up and left.
Aplastic anemia (pancytopenia) after antibiotic for meningitis in Guatemala — chloramphenicol is classic association.
Ménétrier disease — hypertrophic gastropathy with rugal enlargement, parietal cell atrophy, protein-losing → edema; from TGF-α driven mucous cell hyperplasia.
DKA already corrected (glucose normalized, K normalized, gap closed); just monitor.
Asymmetric oligoarthritis, axial involvement, nail pitting, dandruff/scalp psoriasis — psoriatic arthritis.
Proximal weakness improving with exercise, autonomic dysfunction (incontinence), no AChE response — Lambert-Eaton from small cell lung cancer.
Infant with opportunistic infections (Candida, RSV, diarrhea), HIV negative — SCID with defective T cell function.
Conduction aphasia (fluent, comprehends, cannot repeat) — arcuate fasciculus lesion.
Hirsutism + acne + oligomenorrhea + obesity + impaired glucose tolerance — PCOS (Rotterdam).
Diabetic peripheral neuropathy (intact ABI excludes PAD) — strict glycemic control prevents progression.
Down syndrome quad screen pattern (↓AFP, ↑hCG, ↓estriol, ↑inhibin A) + polyhydramnios + bilious vomiting in newborn — duodenal atresia.
Coronary sinus has the lowest O2 content at rest and exercise (myocardium extracts maximally at rest, cannot extract more with exercise).
Multiparous woman with heavy menses, pelvic heaviness, urinary frequency — fibroids producing irregular, enlarged uterus.
Severe anion-gap metabolic acidosis (AG=27), normal salicylates, AKI (Cr 2), homeless alcoholic — ethylene glycol; treat with fomepizole.
Calf claudication with absent pedal pulses and palpable femoral pulse — femoropopliteal artery stenosis.
ACOG: fetal autopsy is the single most useful test in stillbirth evaluation.
Type II pneumocytes (surfactant-producing) proliferate to regenerate damaged alveolar epithelium.
Ionizing radiation produces double-strand DNA breaks.
Resistant hypertension with hypokalemia and metabolic alkalosis — primary hyperaldosteronism.
Conjugated hyperbilirubinemia with bilirubinuria and low urobilinogen indicates obstructed bile excretion.
Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) causing cholinergic diarrhea/cramps — antimuscarinic atropine reverses.
Slowly developing orofacial dyskinesia after months of haloperidol — tardive dyskinesia.
Tinea cruris — confirm with KOH prep showing hyphae.
Risperidone causes hyperprolactinemia → gynecomastia, galactorrhea.
Toxic shock syndrome from tampon-related S. aureus TSST-1; superantigen binds Vβ region of TCR and MHC II.
Post-bloody diarrhea in child with MAHA (schistocytes), thrombocytopenia, AKI — HUS (EHEC).
Bulimia: patients can have crossover history of anorexia and bulimia (overlap is well-described).
Returned from Indonesia, fever, abdominal pain, hepatosplenomegaly, rose spots — typhoid (Salmonella typhi).
Metronidazole + alcohol → disulfiram-like reaction; acetaldehyde accumulates.
Physiologic anemia of pregnancy (dilutional); Hb 11.1 with normal MCV at 16 weeks is within normal limits — no further workup.
Postoperative urinary retention with bladder discomfort — straight catheterization for diagnosis and decompression.

Oral candidiasis in immunocompetent host — oral fluconazole inhibits 14-α-demethylase (or could use nystatin which disrupts membrane). Given systemic-acting first-line for oropharyngeal candidiasis, fluconazole.
Cancer history with night-worsening back pain — metastatic disease; NSCLC produces osteolytic bone lesions.
Life-threatening emergency in minor with parents unreachable — proceed with surgery under implied consent.
Maternal Graves' (even post-thyroidectomy) — TSI (TSH receptor antibodies) cross placenta causing neonatal hyperthyroidism.
Post-variceal hemorrhage secondary prophylaxis: nonselective beta-blocker (nadolol) + band ligation.
Cirrhotic with 2 cm lesion, arterial enhancement, washout pattern — diagnostic for HCC; resect if compensated.
Cirrhotic with encephalopathy and fever + ascites — SBP is the precipitating factor.
Blunt chest trauma with elevated troponins, elevated PCWP, sinus tachycardia, chest wall bruising — cardiac contusion.
Hepatorenal syndrome (rising Cr, oliguria, low urine Na, no proteinuria/blood, post-SBP) — definitive treatment is liver transplant.
Hyperthyroidism (likely Graves'); single best definitive treatment is radioactive iodine ablation.
Tinea versicolor (hypopigmented patches after sun exposure) — KOH prep shows 'spaghetti and meatballs'.
Cri-du-chat: high-pitched cry, microcephaly, epicanthal folds — deletion on chromosome 5p.
Postmenopausal woman with vaginal mass — biopsy to rule out malignancy.
Hereditary hemochromatosis (high ferritin, transferrin sat, diabetes, MCP arthropathy) — arthropathy from CPPD crystal deposition.
Cyanotic newborn with egg-shaped heart, single S2, treated with septostomy — transposition of great vessels.
Penetrating cardiac wound to RV — interrupted polypropylene sutures with pledgets is standard repair.
Chronic bronchitis (smoker, productive cough, edema/cor pulmonale) — Reid index >50%.
Follicular lymphoma t(14;18) → BCL-2 overexpression → inhibits intrinsic apoptosis pathway involving caspase-9.
African-American — acral lentiginous melanoma is the most common subtype in darker-skinned individuals.
Polymyalgia rheumatica (proximal stiffness, elevated ESR/CRP, age) associated with giant cell arteritis — screen for jaw claudication.
Cyclic pelvic pain, dyspareunia, dyschezia, infertility — endometriosis (endometrial tissue outside uterus).
Prosthetic valve patient with fever and splinter hemorrhages — infective endocarditis; vegetations (friable masses on valve) on echo.
Suspected endometriosis with normal ultrasound — laparoscopy is gold standard for diagnosis.
LDL 186 with family history of premature CAD — definite indication for statin therapy.
Widened mediastinum, fractured 1st/2nd rib, NG deviation, depressed mainstem bronchus — thoracic aortic rupture.
Graves' in 1st trimester pregnancy — PTU preferred (methimazole teratogenic in 1st trimester).
Schistosoma mansoni (lateral-spined eggs, granulomatous periportal fibrosis) — transmitted by freshwater snails in Africa.
Tetralogy of Fallot: chronic hypoxia masks iron deficiency anemia because Hb may appear 'normal' but is inappropriately low for the polycythemic stimulus.
Acute fluctuating altered mental status with inattention in elderly post-op patient — delirium.
Atlantoaxial instability (clunk on cervical manipulation) — strongly associated with Down syndrome.
Cardiac tamponade (muffled heart sounds, JVD, hypotension) — pulsus paradoxus (drop >10 mmHg in SBP with inspiration).
ADPKD with bilateral flank masses and family history — screen for intracranial berry aneurysms with MR angiography.
PE treated with IV heparin but PTT remains normal → antithrombin III deficiency (heparin resistance); autosomal dominant.
Recurrent gonorrhea — Neisseria gonorrhoeae undergoes pilus antigenic variation, preventing lasting immunity.
MVA with neck pain — first step is cervical spine immobilization before imaging.
Antipsychotics (haloperidol, fluphenazine, risperidone) block D2 → hyperprolactinemia → galactorrhea; bromocriptine is a dopamine agonist that LOWERS prolactin, so it would NOT cause these symptoms.
